build: Modwerk's linker (scripts/link-image.mjs): the Modwerk base for core-ar2 0.7 (plain variant ba530f45, vendored) + this folder's voice-dac 1.4.0 package, materialised against stock OS 1.74 (cb0f99d6…e123), --version VD14

emulator.name: analog-emu (trigcondition's Rytm and A4 emulator built on rytm-emu; its history holds rytm-emu c5732f0, 951dcbc and e914f46)
emulator.settings: no card image, JIT on, --every 1000M; DTBOOT_STEPS=1 DTBOOT_PNG_DIR=out DTBOOT_TURN_PNG=out

conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices. GLOBAL, twelve UP and five DOWN presses and YES open AUDIO ROUTING; twenty DOWN presses reach its last row and RIGHT sets DAC SUM ON; two NO presses return home; TRIG, then FLTR twice, opens DAC FILTER on BD. Encoder 2 (knob C, TYP) turns +4 ten times 100M apart (OFF to LP2), a NO press redraws the settled page, then twelve more turns (LP2 to LP1) and a NO press. Stock 1.74 with the same input gives byte-identical frames until AUDIO ROUTING opens; there its list ends at USB TO MAIN, and FLTR pressed twice stays on stock's FILTER page. Playback was not judged in the emulator: its analog voices are stubbed.
